title: A worker's manual repro setup goes under its scratch directory, which dispatch cleans
goal: the worker brief tells a worker that runs repro setup or another bench command by hand to set BENCH_SCRATCH to its item's scratch directory, so its throwaway clones are removed with the scratch and none is left under the system temp directory (SP-a3w7xdij: BG-5qgk6hgb's worker left a repro instance clone under $TMPDIR/it-ops-kb-bench, rm denied)

run:
import sys
t=open('_tools/bl_dispatch.py',encoding='utf-8').read()+open('.claude/agents/kb-worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
sys.exit(0 if 'BENCH_SCRATCH' in t else 1)
